description: What the main window's webview may ask of the app: its own twenty-two commands (listed in build.rs) and nothing else: `boot`, `engine_command`, `daemon_resolve_current`, `daemon_switch`, `storage_set`, `dialog_confirm`, `dialog_alert`, `open_external`, `save_begin`, `save_write`, `save_finish`, `save_discard`, `upload_pick`, `transfer_upload`, `transfer_save`, `transfer_cancel`, `transfers_set`, `preview_mount`, `preview_release`, `transport_open` (opens the proxied connection to the current entry's daemon and answers a single-use loopback address) and `ssh_config_hosts` (lists the plain `Host` names of `~/.ssh/config` for the SSH form) and `window_set_zoom` (sets the window's page zoom, 0.5 to 2). `transfer_upload` and `transfer_save` run a file transfer on the app's own connection to the current entry's daemon, by a handle the app issued; `transfer_cancel` stops one. Of the core permissions only listening for events is granted (`core:event:allow-listen` and `allow-unlisten`; Tauri cannot scope them to names, and the app emits only `daemons_changed`, `daemons_manage`, `connection_resume` and `transfer_progress`): the page calls no window API and emits nothing, and dialogs, file dialogs and links are opened from Rust. The origin that serves previewed documents is granted nothing: no capability names it and there is no remote-origin grant.
